column1: # Table S11-3 | Robustness checks for baseline PPML model (GDELT, total trade)

# Notes: Baseline: h=0, total trade, GDELT. AR(1) residual: dedicated AR(1)-residual shock construction from the fair-coverage pipeline (cumulative effect 0.072 [0.008, 0.136]; main-text Table 2). The k = 24 scan point is from the same frequency-response pipeline. Frequency scan: k-month rolling sum of political shock. Forward effects: lead shock at h. Sample exclusions: the United States, the pandemic period (2020-01–2021-06), Iran, truncation to 2019-03, 1% trade outliers. Controls: ln(GDP_i×GDP_j), ln(exchange rate), FTA dummy. Fixed effects: country and year-month. Standard errors clustered at country level. ***p<0.001, **p<0.01, *p<0.05.
